grande-lakes-orlando-2026.tape: On Aug 10, 2026, RHP agreed to buy the fee-simple interest in the 1,010-room JW Marriott and the 582-room Ritz-Carlton at Grande Lakes, with an 18-hole Greg Norman course on 409 acres, for approximately $1.38 billion, and put $50 million into escrow. RHP disclosed a 6.6% cap rate on trailing-12-month net operating income (NOI) of $91.2 million to June 30, 2026 (Adjusted EBITDAre of $110.0 million less an $18.8 million FF&E reserve, from unaudited, seller-provided data) and a 12.5x Adjusted EBITDAre multiple. The resort carried an $800 million floating-rate CMBS loan (ORL 2024-GLKS) that the buyer could elect to assume. RHP said it would fund the purchase with cash on hand and debt, which may include assuming that loan, alongside an equity offering of 5.1 million shares launched the same day. Marriott continues to manage both hotels under their existing brands.
grande-lakes-orlando-2026.watches_for: The $867k per key is an average across a luxury hotel, an upper-upscale hotel, a golf course and 409 acres. The public documents don't split the price among them, so it shouldn't be read as the value of either hotel on its own.

Projected 2026 new-build openings: 1,988 rooms (free industry press release), equal to 1.50% of the same base.
Existing rooms: 132,685 at year-end 2025 (Visit Orlando Data & Trends, archived June 11, 2026). Each figure above comes from a different publisher, and geographies may differ.

demand.text: June 2026 alone: $33.6M of tourist development tax collections, down 0.4% from June 2025. Fiscal year to date (Oct 2025 to Jun 2026): up 8.7% on the county's basis. Neither figure is scored.
Orange County Convention Center (OCCC): FY2025-26 projection of 185 events and 2.3M attendees.
OCCC FY2027 forecast at the county budget workshop: about 170 events and 2.1M attendees (press report).

OCCC Phase 5A Grand Concourse ($560M, funded by the tourist development tax): a 100,000 sq ft ballroom plus 44,000 sq ft of meeting space. Groundbreaking was Dec 17, 2025, and completion is scheduled for 2029.

Visit Orlando board minutes (June 9, 2026 meeting): group attendance had reached 18.8% of its goal through April 2026 (reported under progress toward Visit Orlando's organizational goals), with room nights slightly below target.
